title: Presence Flink
description: Local Flink operations: cluster capacity, task flow, membership, checkpoints, RocksDB native state and shared JVM.

options.content:
**1 JobManager · 1 TaskManager · 2 slots · 4 branches at parallelism 2 · 16 keys per branch · N = 1,000 per key**

**Dark** = scalable · **Gray** = fixed · **Dashed** = managed state. Fresh IDs, repeats and tombstones; **1s** statistics/export, **2s** checkpoints.

Cluster → task flow → membership → checkpoints → RocksDB → shared JVM. The State Backend card identifies this run.

panels.title: TaskManagers
panels.description: Registered TaskManagers, reported by the JobManager.

panels.title: Slots Used
panels.description: Allocated physical task slots. Multiple chained/shared tasks can use a slot; this is not the number of operators.

panels.title: Slots Total
panels.description: Physical task slots registered with the JobManager.

panels.title: Running Jobs
panels.description: Running jobs in this MiniCluster. Falls to zero at bounded-job completion.

panels.title: Job Restarts
panels.description: This smoke disables restart; zero is expected.

panels.title: State Backend
panels.description: Actual configured Flink state backend for this run. Presence HEAP branches still keep membership outside managed state.

panels.title: Records Entering Each Branch
panels.description: Native Flink record counters, summed over subtasks per branch. Fan-out sends the same inputs to all four branches; do not add them as unique source events.

panels.title: Busiest Subtask
panels.description: Highest busy fraction in each task. Unsupported negative/NaN values are omitted. Task chains include the verifier sink; this is not Bloom-only CPU.

panels.title: Backpressure by Task
panels.description: Worst subtask backpressure fraction per task. This gently paced smoke may remain at zero.

panels.title: Network Buffer Memory
panels.description: Flink shuffle buffer usage and capacity. MiniCluster uses local transport; it does not demonstrate a cross-machine network workload.

panels.title: Keyed Blooms
panels.description: One Bloom group per key per branch; all 4 branches together.

panels.title: Bit-Array Payload
panels.description: Exact array payload across all resident filters. Excludes object headers, keys, maps, workspace and Flink runtime.

panels.title: Allocated Layers
panels.description: Sum across all four branches, including each fixed Bloom's one layer.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Local filesystem checkpoints cover managed branches. HEAP branches intentionally warn that membership is not durable.

panels.title: Allocated Bit Arrays
panels.description: Cached payload bytes per branch, summed over subtasks. Fixed stays bounded; scalable adds layers.

panels.title: Allocated Layers
panels.description: Scalable layers grow independently per key. Tombstones discard the selected key's old membership.

panels.title: Estimated Memberships
panels.description: Occupancy estimates summed across keys, not an exact input counter. Near saturation the fixed estimate becomes unreliable.

panels.title: Key Distribution Across Subtasks
panels.description: Live resident groups for each of the eight operator subtasks. Parallelism and key partitioning determine the distribution.

panels.title: Highest Active Fill
panels.description: Maximum across keys/subtasks. Fixed occupancy grows; scalable rolls over its active layer.

panels.title: Highest Estimated False-Positive Probability
panels.description: Worst resident key estimate, not a sum over keys and not measured false positives.

panels.title: Statistics Refresh Cost
panels.description: Last synchronous scan duration. Runs on the operator thread after a due operation, delaying that operation. This is not a latency percentile.

panels.title: Statistics Refreshes
panels.description: Actual sampling passes across subtasks; idle operators retain their cached sample. Final manual refresh runs before job shutdown.

panels.title: Forwarded Records / Second
panels.description: All fresh IDs and one quarter of repeated IDs are forwarded. Seed/control records also count.

panels.title: Dropped Records / Second
panels.description: Three quarters of immediate repeats are deliberately dropped. Counter deltas are accumulated by the Collector.

panels.title: Possible Duplicates / Second
panels.description: Possible matches include known repeats and false positives. They do not measure false-positive rate.

panels.title: Membership Resets
panels.description: One rotating tenant receives a tombstone after every 3,000 source cycles, approximately every 15 seconds.

panels.title: Layer Writes / Second
panels.description: Dirty layer writes to Flink MapState, coordinated with checkpoints. This is managed state activity, not storage IOPS.

panels.title: Layer Payload Written / Second
panels.description: Serialized layer payload handed to MapState. Excludes metadata and checkpoint backend overhead.

panels.title: Layer Reads
panels.description: Reads occur on lazy restoration. This smoke has no restart, so zero is expected. Heap remains the lookup path.

panels.title: Completed and Failed Checkpoints
panels.description: Checkpoint counts for the job. A completed checkpoint is not a recovery test.

panels.title: Last Checkpoint Duration
panels.description: Most recently completed checkpoint duration reported by Flink.

panels.title: Last Full Checkpoint Size
panels.description: Flink's full checkpoint size; includes more than Bloom bit arrays.

options.content:
Run **`mise run telemetry:flink:rocksdb`** to populate these sections. HashMap runs show **No data** here. Presence still performs membership lookups on heap; RocksDB holds the managed-state copy.

**Native memory is outside Java heap.** Shared cache readings overlap across column families/operators in a slot, so cache charts show per-subtask observations, never an added total. Flink refreshes native views periodically (typically **5s**); 1s export does not make those views fresher.

panels.title: Memtables by Branch
panels.description: Native memtable footprint summed over column families/subtasks per branch. Includes Flink timer state; HEAP branches can have runtime state even though their Bloom membership is not managed.

panels.title: SST Reader Memory
panels.description: Native table-reader memory estimates, excluding block cache. Sum of state column-family/subtask readings, not total RocksDB RSS.

panels.title: Shared Block Cache Usage
panels.description: Maximum across column families within each operator subtask removes repeated observations there. Operators in the same slot may still share this cache: never sum the lines.

panels.title: Shared Block Cache Capacity
panels.description: Configured cache capacity observed per subtask. Shared across operators in a slot, not additional allocated bytes for each line.

panels.title: Live SST Files
panels.description: SST bytes in the current version, summed over state families/subtasks. Not checkpoint storage size, full filesystem usage, or Bloom array payload.

panels.title: Native Bytes Written / Second
panels.description: Uncompressed logical RocksDB writes, from cumulative native ticker gauges. Excludes compaction writes; not physical disk throughput.

panels.title: Compaction Bytes Written / Second
panels.description: Native compaction output rate. A short, small run may perform little compaction; zero is valid.

panels.title: Pending Compaction Bytes
panels.description: Estimated work remaining for level compaction across state families. This small smoke is not expected to create a backlog.

panels.title: Flush Pending
panels.description: 1 means at least one state family has a pending memtable flush in this subtask. Periodic samples can miss brief flushes; zero does not prove that no flush occurred.

panels.title: Writer Stall Time
panels.description: Cumulative native writer wait time due to flush/compaction pressure. Zero is expected under this paced workload.

panels.title: Block Cache Hits / Second
panels.description: Native cache hits from RocksDB operations, not Presence Bloom lookups. The hot membership path stays on heap.

panels.title: Block Cache Misses / Second
panels.description: Native cache misses, not Bloom false positives. May remain zero when the workload does little backend reading.

panels.title: Writes Stopped
panels.description: Native write-stopped flag per subtask, deduplicated across state families. Zero is healthy; No data means absent telemetry.

panels.title: Background Errors
panels.description: DB-level cumulative background errors may be repeated on column-family metrics; take max within each operator subtask rather than summing families.

panels.title: Heap Memory
panels.description: One TaskManager JVM metric stream. JobManager and TaskManager share this process: do not add their heap readings together.

panels.title: Non-Heap and Direct Buffers
panels.description: Whole process overhead, including class metadata, code and direct buffers. Not total native RSS.

panels.title: GC Elapsed Time
panels.description: Cumulative elapsed GC time for the smoke JVM's G1 collector. Not a stop-the-world pause histogram.

panels.title: Process CPU Load
panels.description: Flink's whole JVM process CPU load, not per-Bloom CPU. Warmup and serialization also contribute.
